title: Run Phase A verification for multi-agent governance documentation PRs
description: Add docs/14-multi-agent/** to the Phase A Verification pull_request path filter so the protected required phase-a status is produced for governance-only multi-agent PRs instead of remaining pending forever.

external_gate_evidence.rule: MEDIUM-risk task evidence is artifact-bound. REVIEW and LOCK evidence must reference the exact current artifact hash and be relayed through the trusted repository-owner transport.

acceptance_criteria.description: The Phase A Verification pull_request path filter includes docs/14-multi-agent/** in addition to all existing paths; no existing trigger path is removed or weakened.
A pull request changing this task's workflow file receives an exact-head phase-a check and the phase-a job completes successfully.
Canonical CI and merge-policy execute on the exact PR head; merge-policy remains fail-closed until valid REVIEW and LOCK evidence exist.
Only the Phase A workflow path filter and this Task Contract are modified; no runtime code, product behavior, database, contracts, package metadata, or other required workflow is changed.
This additive change does not create or revive any bootstrap exception and must merge only through the canonical Merge Policy Controller path.
